decisions.reason: As a modular trommel screen it is very close to the firm's long-established screening know-how, and the visible renaming and continued development from BASIC 518 to 518 FLEX suggest the firm has been able to learn from market feedback and improve it.

Mobile high-speed flail shredders fit the firm's core mobile waste-processing machinery business, and the 2019 Stage V update across the AK range indicates continued investment rather than withdrawal.

A mobile high-speed grinder is still strongly related to the firm's existing shredding and processing capabilities, and its move from a mention in 2018 to a dedicated page in 2019 points to growing internal commitment and absorptive learning.

Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders are highly complementary to the firm's established stationary and shredding portfolio, and the firm's explicit claim of setting standards with the new CERON generation signals strong confidence and low likelihood of exit.
